about: One meaning per form of a variable field that names a current-row value, on a 1.0 tree. In a row's read (#2934), a bare between.value is an output column alone (NAME-3), a driver-qualified name reads the row's driver record and a lookup-qualified name reads that lookup's column for the row (LOOKUP-9); a key match value never reads a lookup's column, a SELF field, a name nothing declares or a bare name no column takes, and its pair refuses it, so the lookup's read fails too (LOOKUP-5, LOOKUP-11); a written aggregate key reports its refusals at its key (LOOKUP-5). In a donor read (#3414) a bare or donor-qualified name reads the donor record and a lookup-qualified one that lookup's column for the donor record, and any other record is refused at the reading derivation (LOOKUP-16). A range value never reads the record of the intermediate that builds its row (#3055), a source binding's range types refusal names its variable (LOOKUP-9), and an empty child layer reports what its parent reports alone (LAYER-5, COLUMN-5). check reports each refusal as build does, in build's order, and leaves out only what the declarations cannot decide, a field a relation does not store, so a specification with such a field is a case of each, _by_check and _by_build. The documents: rows has clinic and home templates over CLINIC and HOME, each deriving ADAY, the row's day, the lookup RK, REF's record of the subject, and W, which nothing derives; base is built from CLINIC's records without row templates, with RK and W deriving WI.NAME; donor is built from CLINIC's records, W reading D.WNAME, which D, REF's record of the subject, derives from WI, the day window whose range holds REFDAY, while RK reads OTHER's record of the subject; dosed has a template over DOSED, the exposure records with a dose, and one over SUBJ, the subjects, each deriving APERIOD null, and W, the subject's first period whose range holds DOSED.EXSTDT; child is an empty layer over spec.yaml. The data: clinic and home measurements of one subject, each with its day and device; the subject's reference day 12 in REF and day 3 in OTHER; the windows EARLY (days 1 to 10) and LATE (11 to 50); the devices' calibration days; and two subjects' exposure records, one without a dose, and their periods. Moved from check_variable_forms.rs, whose tests compared each issue's phase, condition, rule, spec paths and context, in order, for build and for check in both hosts, and the out.csv a clean run saved, whose save returned true, as migrated_api_contracts.json keeps; a child layer's rows are its parent's, which the case of the parent specification states. A case writes the files its specification names and runs for the default host, since a request without a project reads no environment entry.
